name: ACCRINTM
description: ACCRINTM returns the accrued interest from the issue date to the maturity date for a zero-coupon or maturity-paying security.
tldr: Calculates accrued interest for a security that pays interest at maturity.

parameters.name: settlement
parameters.description: Date the security matures or is sold.

basicExample.description: Accrued interest for a maturity-paying bond
basicExample.explanation: Calculates accrued interest for a full year on a 6% bond with $1,000 par value.

advancedExamples.title: With actual/360 basis
advancedExamples.explanation: Money market instruments often use actual/360 day count.

howItWorks: ACCRINTM calculates the total interest accrued from issue to maturity. It is used for securities that pay all interest at maturity rather than periodically.

howToSteps.name: Calculate
howToSteps.text: Press Enter to get the result.

limitations: Dates must be valid Excel dates.
Basis 0 is the most common convention for US bonds.

commonErrors.fix: Use DATE function or valid date serial numbers.

googleSheetsEquivalent.description: ACCRINTM works identically in Google Sheets.
googleSheetsEquivalent.notes: Same syntax and behavior as Excel.

faq.question: What is the difference between ACCRINT and ACCRINTM?
faq.answer: ACCRINT is for periodic coupon payments. ACCRINTM is for securities that pay interest at maturity.

faq.question: When should I use ACCRINTM?
faq.answer: Use it for zero-coupon bonds or Treasury bills that pay interest at maturity.
